friendly_name: Mission Status Read API: artifact reads and dashboard route inventory
purpose_context: The bundled dashboard was removed in #5545. Its artifact views now get a home in the open-core Mission Status Read API (listArtifacts, getArtifactContent), and every other removed route is mapped to a contract operation, a governance --json verb, or recorded as dropped (#5533, #957).
purpose_tldr: Serve a Mission's artifacts read-only through the Mission Status service and account for every removed dashboard route.
